measurements.text: 将3个或更多同类方块连成一线，即可收集。点击此气泡继续。
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: Each tile matched after the first 3 gives a chance at double tile bonus. Match more tiles for more chances to get bonus tiles
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: 连线超过3格后，每多连一格，就多一次获得双倍方块奖励的机会。连得越长，奖励机会越多。
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: Collecting coins gives you gold
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: 收集钱币可获得金币。
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: Collecting potions replenishes your health, or does nothing if your health is full
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: 收集药水可恢复生命；生命已满时没有效果。
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: Collecting swords on their own gives you nothing. Match swords with skulls to damage enemies
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: 只收集剑不会获得任何东西。将剑与骷髅相连，才能伤害敌人。
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: Collecting shields repairs your armour and adds upgrade points
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: 收集盾牌可修复护甲，并获得强化点。
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: Killing enemies gives you experience points
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: 击杀敌人可获得经验。
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: Collecting gold fills up the gold box. Fill it up completely to buy new items
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: 收集金币会填充金币槽。填满后即可购买新装备。
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: Match skulls and swords to damage enemies. The damage is equal to the base damage plus weapon damage per matched sword
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: 将骷髅与剑相连可伤害敌人。伤害等于基础伤害，加上每把相连的剑提供的武器伤害。
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: This number shows your base damage value. This is the minimum damage you will do to all matched skulls
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: 这个数字是你的基础伤害，也是每个相连骷髅受到的最低伤害。
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: This number shows your weapon damage. Each sword you match will add this much damage to each skull
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: 这个数字是你的武器伤害。每连一把剑，每个骷髅受到的伤害就增加这么多。
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: Collecting shields while your armour is damaged repairs it. Repair armour to deflect some or all of the enemies' damage
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: 护甲受损时，收集盾牌可修复护甲。护甲能抵挡部分或全部敌人伤害。
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: Collecting shields when your armour is fully repaired fills up the upgrade bar. Fill it up completely to upgrade your items
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: 护甲已修满时，收集盾牌会填充强化条。填满后即可强化装备。
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: Collecting experience points fills up the experience bar. Fill it up completely to level up and improve your stats and skills
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: 获得经验会填充经验条。填满后即可升级，提升属性与技能。
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: Your health is low! Collect potions to refill your health, or kill skulls and repair your armour to buy yourself some time
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: 生命危险！收集药水恢复生命，或击杀骷髅、修复护甲，为自己争取时间。
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: This is an enemy! The white number shows its attack, blue defence and red health. Match enemies and swords to damage them
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: 这是敌人！白色数字表示攻击，蓝色表示防御，红色表示生命。将敌人与剑相连即可造成伤害。
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: Enemies attack you each turn for the sum of all their attack values
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: 敌人每回合都会攻击你，伤害等于所有敌人的攻击总和。
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: Damage is reduced by your current armour value. The left number shows your current armour, the right your maximum armour. Repair current armour up to maximum by collecting shields
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: 当前护甲可减免伤害。左侧数字是当前护甲，右侧是护甲上限。收集盾牌可修复护甲，直至上限。
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: Damage not blocked by your armour is subtracted from your health. The game ends when your health reaches 0
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: 护甲未挡住的伤害会扣除生命。生命降至0时，游戏结束。
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: A skill is ready to activate. Tap and hold it to see its description, release to activate it
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: 一个技能已就绪。按住查看说明，松手即可发动。
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: This skill is now active and will provide its effects until the end of the current turn
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: 这个技能已生效，效果持续至本回合结束。
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: This is a special enemy! Special monsters are not affected by most skills. Tap it to find out its special abilities and effects
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: 这是特殊敌人！多数技能对特殊怪物无效。点击查看它的特殊能力与效果。
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: Killing special enemies nets you a lot of gold and XP, and in some cases potions
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line

measurements.text: 击杀特殊敌人可获得大量金币和经验，有时还会掉落药水。
measurements.basis: ui-layout help.panel w=313.6, help.text inset=19.2; symmetric inset estimate; height grows 16px per line
